definitions.explanation: A product or item made according to specific customer requirements rather than being mass-produced. Implies customization in size, material, design, or other specifications.

examples.japanese: このスーツは{特注|とくちゅう}で{作|つく}った。
{特注|とくちゅう}の{家具|かぐ}は{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}いが{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: Custom-made furniture is expensive but lasts a long time.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}が{大|おお}きいので、{靴|くつ}はいつも{特注|とくちゅう}で{頼|たの}んでいる。
examples.english: Since I'm large, I always order shoes custom-made.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for {特別|とくべつ}{注文|ちゅうもん} (special order). Used as a noun or as a の-adjective: {特注|とくちゅう}の{品|しな} (a custom-made item), {特注|とくちゅう}{品|ひん} (custom product). Common in contexts involving clothing, furniture, equipment, and any goods that can be tailored to individual specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特注|とくちゅう}{品|ひん}: custom-made product
- {特注|とくちゅう}で{作|つく}る: to have custom-made
- {特注|とくちゅう}の{家具|かぐ}: custom furniture
- {特注|とくちゅう}サイズ: custom size
